findings.message: Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 3 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "10:25" at 18 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
"Partout au Niger" (3 words) is on screen 0.93 s (±0.01 s), under its 1.05 s floor: hold it about 0.5 s + 0.3 s a word (1.40 s here) before it leaves or changes; see references/motion.md.

The film's last line "Beauté Confiance Bien-être" (4 words) is on screen 1.62 s (±0.01 s), under the 2.00 s a closing line needs: hold it about 0.5 s + 0.3 s a word and at least 2 s before the film ends; see references/motion.md.
